messages:
ava: Posting fresh mock and a few open questions about the latency card: heatmap density, keyboard nav for buckets, and the sampling control interaction. Want small-screen behavior nailed.
celeste: Thanks! I skimmed the mock. Can you list the actionable decisions we need to make?
ava: Sure: 1) sampling control: slider vs compact dropdown. 2) heatmap accessibility: grid roles + focus order. 3) p95 tooltip phrasing and concise unit display. 4) whether a pin is per-panel or workspace-level.
rui: My quick take: dropdown for sampling is easier to discover; slider is nice for power users but harder to a11y. Maybe both: dropdown presets + an advanced slider hidden behind "custom".
jamal: Agree on presets+custom. Backend note: we need to cap the slider min to 1% to avoid accidental 0.1% queries that spike cost.
morgan: Ops prefers default sample=5% for heatmap queries across orgs with >100k events, but allow user override. We can expose an org policy to set a default.
celeste: UX: show the effective sample rate in the header: "Data sample: 5% (org default)" and an inline help icon linking to docs.
lisa: Accessibility: heatmap must be navigable by keyboard in row-major order. Use role="grid" with each cell role="gridcell" and aria-label like "bucket 3 of 12, 78 requests, median 36ms, 95th 210ms". Avoid announcing every update; only announce when user stops scrubbing (aria-live polite after 300ms).
ava: Proposed snippet for cell labels: 
```
role="gridcell" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Bucket (2/8): 42 reqs, p95 184 ms"
```
When focused, set tabindex=0 and announce concise summary.
rui: Nice. Also consider a visible focus halo that meets AA contrast. we use global token outline-focus-3.
celeste: For mobile, tapping a bucket should open a bottom sheet showing the full metrics and sparklines. Also include a link to open the raw logs in Insights.
jamal: On p95 tooltip copy, product requested: short form on hover: "p95: 214 ms". On keyboard focus, expand to full phrase: "95th percentile latency: 214 milliseconds" (for SR clarity).
lisa: Good plan. For screen readers, prefer the long form as the accessible name and keep short hover for sighted users. Also mark decorative SVG gradients aria-hidden="true".
morgan: Performance question: heatmap currently renders in Canvas for perf. That complicates per-cell semantics. Do we switch to SVG for a11y?
ava: We're trying hybrid: Canvas for paint, but overlay an invisible accessible DOM grid (offscreen/opacity=0) that mirrors buckets for SR and keyboard. Thoughts?
lisa: That's acceptable if the DOM mirror is kept in sync and not duplicated visually (use aria-hidden on canvas). Ensure focus moves to mirror cells and pointer events pass-through to canvas.
jamal: Implementation complexity noted. Might add ~120ms to render on large panels; we can lazy-mount mirror only when a11y mode or keyboard detected.
celeste: UX: the legend header should show units. Proposal: "Latency — ms" (compact) and then inline percentiles: "p50 · p95". On tiny widths remove dots and show stacked abbreviations.
rui: For sampling control label change: don't use "sample rate" (confusing). Use "data sample" or "sampled data"? Which is clearer?
celeste: Product prefers "Data sample". It's short and maps to docs.
ava: Another tiny interaction: time range pinning. Two options we debated: per-panel pin (user-level) or view-level pin that applies to whole dashboard for the session. I propose: default = per-panel user pin, plus a separate "Sync range across view" toggle at top of dashboard for power users.
morgan: Ops: sync toggle must be opt-in and non-destructive for shared persisted dashboards. If someone enables sync, it should not change the saved dashboard state unless they explicitly save.
ava: Agreed. We'll keep sync ephemeral until save. Visual affordance: when synced, each card shows a faint connecting bar at the top and a tooltip "Range synced".
lisa: Keyboard shortcuts: propose T opens range picker, S opens sampling presets, and ? opens shortcuts. Make shortcuts discoverable in the help modal. Ensure they are remappable in user settings.
rui: For reduced-motion, do not animate heatmap cell hover transitions or scrubber movement. Read from prefers-reduced-motion or user pref.
morgan: We'll add a user-pref flag for reduced-motion and expose it in the prefs endpoint. Client will fallback to media query if not set.
ajamal: small API note: we'll add endpoint /api/v1/baselines?metric=latency&compare=previous_deploy that returns a thin timeseries for overlay. No heavy compute.
celeste: Overlay toggle idea: add small dashed baseline icon in the legend to compare to a baseline. product liked this.
ava: Final design copy changes: legend title -> "Latency (ms)", tooltip short -> "p95: 214 ms", sampling label -> "Data sample", heatmap bucket abbreviations -> show units only in legend. I'll update Figma and a11y checklist.
design-bot: Ava uploaded updated file -> https://redwood.app/figma/compact-heatmap-sampling-ux.
ava: Thanks all. Let's reconvene tomorrow 11am PT to review the updated prototype and implementation tasks.
